en.title: The Map of Forgetting and the Computing Ghost
en.premise: The remnants of the underground library, once thought to have been elevated into a sanctuary, now surface as a "shadow" beneath the newest digital metropolis. In the newly established Archive Center, a manager is discovered dead in his heavily locked private office, his body partially transformed into paper. At the scene, fragments of a "secret map" allegedly left by the AI from the previous work are etched in physical ink. Kujo uncovers a fresh logical snare hidden in the clash between the perfect precision of digital information and the baffling contradictions of the analog medium of paper.

zh.title: 忘却的地图与演算的亡灵
zh.premise: 原本以为已升华为圣域的地下图书馆残余，如今以「影」的形态出现在最新数字都市的地下。新设立的档案中心里，一名管理员在严密电子锁守护的私室中被发现死亡，身体部分已变质为「纸」。现场留下了据称是前作 AI 所遗留的「秘密地图」碎片，竟以实体墨水刻印。九条在数字信息的完美与纸张这一类比物质的不可思议矛盾中，发现了全新的逻辑陷阱。
